items.fullText: 핫픽! 미국주식 핫픽! 미국주식 "끝난줄 알았더니 대반전"…마이크로소프트,사상최고가 눈앞 입력 2026.10.14 00:44 수정 2026.10.14 00:44 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 김정아 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. AI 기사요약 마이크로소프트가 클라우드 사업의 강력한 성장세와 AI 수익화에 대한 긍정적인 전망에 힘입어 주가 사상 최고치를 경신하고 시가총액 4조 달러를 돌파하는 등 투자 심리가 크게 개선되고 있습니다. 6월 폭락이후 시가총액 2천조원 늘어나 AI수익화 유리한 위치…애져 클라우드 컴퓨팅 호조 월가 72명 분석가중 68명이 '매수'의견 로이터연합뉴스 마이크로소프트 주가가 약 1년 만에 사상 최고치를 경신할 전망이다. 뉴욕 현지시간으로 13일 오전 10시 기준 마이크로소프트 주가는 1.8% 상승한 551.13달러를 기록하며 2025년 10월에 세웠던 최고치를 경신할 것으로 보인다. 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. AI 포인트 뷰 이전 분석 종목 다음 분석 종목 본 서비스의 AI가 제공하는 종목 정보는 정보 제공 목적의 참고 자료일 뿐, 투자 권유·자문·추천에 해당하지 않습니다. 투자에 따른 손실 책임은 사용자에게 있습니다. 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 김정아 객원기자 기자로 14년, 자본시장에서 18년 일했습니다. 글로벌 기업과 자본시장을 주시하고 있습니다. 기사댓글 개의 댓글이 있습니다. 댓글 닫기

Emergence Day Is Here Gears of War: E-Day is now streaming on GeForce NOW following its global release on Tuesday, Oct. 6. Set 14 years before the original Gears of War , the prequel follows Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago as they confront the terrifying arrival of the Locust Horde on Emergence Day. The series’ brutal combat, desperate survival and larger-than-life action return with a new origin story for the legendary partnership. Ultimate members can take on the Horde with GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud, plus technologies including NVIDIA DLSS and NVIDIA Reflex . From campaign missions to cooperative and competitive modes, GeForce NOW keeps the fight ready across low-power laptops, Macs, mobile devices, handhelds, Firefox and other browsers, and more — no massive downloads or expensive gaming rig required. items.fullText: From Training to Production, NVIDIA and CoreWeave Close the Loop on Agentic AI NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPU on CoreWeave accelerate agentic AI for companies including Cognition, extending a nearly decade-long run on NVIDIA infrastructure that stays productive, durable and fungible across generations. September 30, 2026 by Stuart Pitts 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Building on nearly a decade of co-engineering, CoreWeave has built NVIDIA compute, networking and software into a cloud purpose-built for AI that’s still returning on investment across multiple generations of deployment. Now, CoreWeave is bringing the next generation of NVIDIA infrastructure to production. At CoreWeave Fully Connected, running this week in San Francisco, CoreWeave announced availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems with Spectrum-X 102.4T Ethernet networking. Cognition, the applied AI lab behind the Devin AI software engineer, is the first customer running production workloads on Vera Rubin. CoreWeave will also offer NVIDIA Vera , the first CPU built for AI agents. In addition, CoreWeave launched CoreWeave Forge, a connected environment for training, evaluating and improving models and agents on NVIDIA accelerated computing. “NVIDIA accelerated computing delivers value across generations,” said Ian Buck, vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing at NVIDIA. “CoreWeave’s NVIDIA V100 GPUs are still running customer workloads nearly a decade after Volta launched, even as CoreWeave brings Vera Rubin NVL72 into production. That’s the strength of the NVIDIA platform: infrastructure that keeps earning for years, and the flexibility to put the right GPU on the right workload. ” Cognition Runs on Vera Rubin NVL72 With 4.8x Higher Token Throughput Cognition runs training, reinforcement learning and production inference for Devin on CoreWeave. September 24, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! A warped Manhattan is waiting in the cloud this week. Remedy Entertainment’s CONTROL Resonant brings Dylan Faden’s extraordinary abilities and a paranatural crisis to GeForce NOW at launch. With the release comes the final days of the CONTROL Resonant Ultimate Membership Bundle . Purchase a 12-month GeForce NOW Ultimate membership through Sunday, Sept. 27, and receive CONTROL Resonant at no additional cost. GeForce NOW support is coming soon to Googlebooks , a new category of laptops bringing together the best of ChromeOS and Android. To top it off, DragonSword: Awakening leads nine new games this week, bringing an anime-style open world to supported devices. Take Control on the Cloud Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in Remedy Entertainment’s CONTROL Resonant . Harness Dylan Faden’s extraordinary abilities to battle the Hiss, the Mold and other reality-bending threats while searching for his sister, Federal Bureau of CONTROL Director Jesse Faden. Dylan must master his new powers and the ever-changing forms of the Aberrant, his paranatural melee weapon, to face a cosmic threat that has escaped the Oldest House and swept through the city. Ultimate members can stream the next chapter of the CONTROL franchise with GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud, including NVIDIA DLSS 4 , ray tracing , NVIDIA Reflex and Cinematic Quality Streaming technologies, with up to 5K high dynamic range on supported devices. Skip the 100GB local install and expensive PC upgrades, and step into the chaos the moment the mission begins.
